{{Quote|Okay, here's the plan for the next couple days. We're gonna ride out into the prairie and bring in the herd. There's about 700 banthas out there, been grazing since last week. We're gonna round 'em up and bring 'em in, probably be back sometime tomorrow night. I got your equipment loaded onto the ycaqt. While you eat, you can ask any questions. '''Jerren Durs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who operated a [[Durs Ranch|leisure ranch]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Froswythe]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a group of individuals stayed at Durs' ranch while on a vacation and early one morning, Durs and his guests rode out on [[ycaqt]]s to round up a herd of [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]]. However, while they were herding the banthas, a [[plains panther]] spooked the creatures and caused them to stampede.
